description: This file defines the SkillPromptInjectionHandler class responsible for extracting skill content from ZIP files, injecting skill content into system prompts for different API styles, creating execution tools, and converting skills to different API formats. It is part of the litellm package dealing with prompt handling and skill integration.

classes.name: SkillPromptInjectionHandler
classes.description: Handles skill content extraction, prompt injection, and tool creation for skill modules within the LiteLLM framework.

methods.name: Optional[str] extract_skill_content(self, skill: LiteLLM_SkillsTable)
methods.description: Extracts skill content from zip files, prioritizing SKILL.md, then README.md, then other markdown files.

methods.name: Dict[str,bytes] extract_all_files(self, skill: LiteLLM_SkillsTable)
methods.description: Extracts all files from a skill ZIP, returning a dict of file paths and contents.

methods.name: dict inject_skill_content_to_messages( self, data: dict, skill_contents: List[str], use_anthropic_format: bool = False )
methods.description: Inserts skill content into the prompt, either into a top-level 'system' parameter (Anthropic) or into the messages array (OpenAI).

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_execute_code_tool(self, skill_modules: List[str])
methods.description: Constructs a tool description enabling the model to execute Python code with access to specified modules.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] convert_skill_to_tool(self, skill: LiteLLM_SkillsTable)
methods.description: Converts a LiteLLM skill into an OpenAI-style function tool, using instructions and metadata.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] convert_skill_to_anthropic_tool(self, skill: LiteLLM_SkillsTable)
methods.description: Converts a LiteLLM skill into an Anthropic API tool format with name, description, and input schema.
